version.description: Version number in the form of "1.1.1".

archicadLocation.description: The location of the Archicad executable in the filesystem.

GetCurrentWindowType.description: Returns the type of the current (active) window.
GetCurrentWindowType.name: GetCurrentWindowType

ChangeWindow.description: Changes the current (active) window to the given window.
ChangeWindow.name: ChangeWindow

userId.description: The stable GSID User ID of the logged-in user.

organizationIds.description: The list of organization IDs the user belongs to. Empty if not part of any organization or if the information cannot be retrieved.

title.description: The title of the alert dialog.

subMessage.description: Optional smaller sub-message text below the main message.

clickedButton.description: Index of the button the user clicked: 1 = button1, 2 = button2, 3 = button3.

folderTypes.description: The types of the special folders to retrieve.

GetSpecialFolders.name: GetSpecialFolders

GetProjectInfo.description: Retrieves information about the currently loaded project.

isUntitled.description: True, if the project is not saved yet.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

projectLocation.description: The location of the project in the filesystem or a BIMcloud project reference.

projectPath.description: The path of the project. A filesystem path or a BIMcloud server relative path.

GetProjectInfoFields.description: Retrieves the names and values of all project info fields.
GetProjectInfoFields.name: GetProjectInfoFields

SetProjectInfoField.description: Sets the value of a project info field.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

CreateProjectInfoFields.description: Creates one or more custom project info fields.

projectInfoFields.description: Array of custom project info fields to create.

projectInfoName.description: Display name of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: Initial value of the project info field.

projectInfoIds.description: List of project info field ids to delete. Only custom fields (ids starting with 'autotext-') can be deleted.

skipNullFloor.description: Floor indices above ground-floor level may start with 1 instead of 0.

projectFilePath.description: The target project file to open.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

ChangeSelectionOfElements.name: ChangeSelectionOfElements

FilterElements.description: Tests an elements by the given criterias.
FilterElements.name: FilterElements

GetDetailsOfElements.description: Gets the details of the given elements (geometry parameters etc).

items.description: Details of an element.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Available for elements with a cut-fill representation (walls, columns, beams). Absent when the element has no cut fill or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

SetDetailsOfElements.description: Sets the details of the given elements (floor, layer, order etc).

Get3DBoundingBoxes.name: Get3DBoundingBoxes

GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements.description: Gets the subelements of the given hierarchical elements.

items.description: Subelements grouped by type.

GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements.name: GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements

GetConnectedElements.description: Gets the elements hosted by (connected to) the given owner elements, filtered to the given element type: for example the Windows or Doors of a Wall, the frames, panels, junctions and accessories of a Curtain Wall, the risers, treads and structures of a Stair, or the posts, rails and panels of a Railing.

elements.description: The owner (host) elements whose connected elements are collected, e.g. Walls, Curtain Walls, Stairs or Railings.

connectedElementType.description: The type of the connected elements to collect, e.g. Window or Door for a Wall owner, or a subelement type of a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing owner.

GetConnectedElements.name: GetConnectedElements

GetSectionElements.description: Gets the elements drawn in the given section, elevation or interior elevation databases, each with the owner element it was generated from. This is the only command that returns raw section element identifiers - every other listing command converts them to their owner - so it is the way to obtain the sectionElementId that CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection requires.

databases.description: The section, elevation or interior elevation databases to list the section elements of. If omitted, the current database is used.

sectionElements.description: The elements drawn in the given databases, each with the owner element it was generated from.

sectionElementId.description: The identifier of the section element itself, accepted by CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection as sectionElementId.

ownerElementId.description: The identifier of the owner element the section element was generated from - this is what every other listing command returns.

ownerElementType.description: The type of the owner element. Only present when the owner's header is readable from the section database.

GetSectionElements.name: GetSectionElements

GetRelationsOfElements.description: Gets the type-specific relations of the given elements: endpoint and reference line connections of walls, beams and beam segments, boundary elements and boundary sections of zones, the zones on the two sides of windows, doors, skylights and curtain wall panels, and the zones connected to roofs and shells. Available from Archicad 26.

otherElementType.description: Optional filter: only relations to elements of this type are returned.

relations.description: Type-specific relations of each element, aligned with the input.

GetRelationsOfElements.name: GetRelationsOfElements

GetZoneBoundaries.description: Gets the boundaries of the given Zone (connected elements, neighbour zones, etc.).
GetZoneBoundaries.name: GetZoneBoundaries

UpdateZones.description: Updates all Zones (recalculates their geometry, updates their Zone Stamps and the connected elements).

keepStampPosition.description: Keep the position of the Zone Stamps. The default is true.

undoTopTrim.description: Undo the trimming of the top of the Zones. The default is false.

undoBottomTrim.description: Undo the trimming of the bottom of the Zones. The default is false.

UpdateZones.name: UpdateZones

GetCollisions.description: Detect collisions between the given two groups of elements.

volumeTolerance.description: Intersection body volume greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

performSurfaceCheck.description: Enables surface collision check. If disabled the surfaceTolerance value will be ignored. By default it's false.

surfaceTolerance.description: Intersection body surface area greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

GetCollisions.name: GetCollisions

HighlightElements.description: Highlights the elements given in the elements array. In case of empty elements array removes all previously set highlights.

highlightedColors.description: A list of colors to highlight elements.

items.description: Color of the highlighted element as an [r, g, b, a] array. Each component must be in the 0-255 range.

wireframe3D.description: Optional parameter. Switch non highlighted elements in the 3D window to wireframe.

nonHighlightedColor.description: Optional parameter. Color of the non highlighted elements as an [r, g, b, a] array. Each component must be in the 0-255 range.

HighlightElements.name: HighlightElements

MoveElements.description: Moves elements with a given vector.

elementsWithMoveVectors.description: The elements with move vector pairs.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, then a copy of the element will be moved. By default it's false.

MoveElements.name: MoveElements

RotateElements.description: Rotates elements around a reference point.

beginPoint.description: Starting point of the rotation arc.

endPoint.description: End point of the rotation arc.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a copy of the element is rotated. By default it's false.

RotateElements.name: RotateElements

LockElements.description: Locks the given elements. Manual lock, not teamwork!
LockElements.name: LockElements

UnlockElements.description: Unlocks the given elements. Manual lock, not teamwork!
UnlockElements.name: UnlockElements

GetGDLParametersOfElements.description: Gets all the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given elements.
GetGDLParametersOfElements.name: GetGDLParametersOfElements

SetGDLParametersOfElements.description: Sets the given GDL parameters of the given elements.

elementsWithGDLParameters.description: The elements with GDL parameters dictionary pairs.

SetGDLParametersOfElements.name: SetGDLParametersOfElements

CreateColumns.description: Creates Column elements based on the given parameters.

columnsData.description: Array of data to create Columns.

items.description: The parameters of the new Column.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

axisRotationAngle.description: Optional column rotation angle in radians.

width.description: Cross section width of the column. Applied to all segments.

depth.description: Cross section depth (height) of the column. Applied to all segments. Only effective for rectangular columns.

coreAnchor.description: Optional anchor point of the column core on a 3x3 grid.

circleBased.description: True for a round column cross section, false for rectangular. Ignored if profileId is also given. Applied to all segments.

isWidthAndHeightLinked.description: When true (the default), Archicad keeps width and depth equal and setting one changes the other - set to false to give width/depth independent values. Applied to all segments.

buildingMaterialId.description: Cross section building material (round or rectangular, per circleBased). Applied to all segments.

profileId.description: Switches the cross section to this custom extruded profile (circleBased becomes false). Applied to all segments.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the coordinate's z value.

CreateColumns.name: CreateColumns

CreateWalls.description: Creates Wall elements based on the given parameters.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

floorIndex.description: Story index (as returned by GetStories). When provided, zCoordinate is interpreted as bottomOffset relative to the floor. Takes priority over zCoordinate for floor assignment.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute Z when floorIndex is absent; bottomOffset relative to the floor when floorIndex is provided.

arcAngle.description: Arc angle in radians; non-zero creates a curved wall (begCoordinate/endCoordinate are the chord endpoints).

CreateWalls.name: CreateWalls

CreateBeams.description: Creates Beam elements based on the given parameters.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

slantAngle.description: Slant angle in radians. A non-zero value also switches the beam to slanted, unless isSlanted is given explicitly.

isSlanted.description: Optional explicit slanted state. By default it is derived from slantAngle.

profileAngle.description: Rotation angle of the profile around the beam's center line, in radians.

width.description: Cross section width of the beam. Applied to all segments.

height.description: Cross section height of the beam. Applied to all segments.

anchorPoint.description: Optional anchor point of the beam cross section on a 3x3 grid.

isWidthAndHeightLinked.description: When true (the default), Archicad keeps width and height equal and setting one changes the other - set to false to give width/height independent values. Applied to all segments.

buildingMaterialId.description: Cross section building material. Applied to all segments.

profileId.description: Switches the cross section to this custom extruded profile. Applied to all segments.

CreateBeams.name: CreateBeams

CreateStairs.description: Creates Stair elements based on the given baseline and parameters.

stairsData.description: Array of data to create Stair elements.

items.description: The parameters of the new Stair.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

baseLinePoints.description: 2D coordinates defining the stair baseline polyline. Minimum 2 points for a straight stair, 3+ for L-shaped or U-shaped stairs.

zCoordinate.description: The Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the stair base.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

CreateStairs.name: CreateStairs

CreateSlabs.description: Creates Slab elements based on the given parameters.

slabsData.description: Array of data to create Slabs.

items.description: The parameters of the new Slab.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

level.description: The Z coordinate value of the reference line of the slab.

referencePlaneLocation.description: Optional location of the slab reference plane. For a basic (homogeneous) slab only 'Top' or 'Bottom' are valid.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the slab.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the slab.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from level.

CreateSlabs.name: CreateSlabs

CreateWindows.description: Creates Window elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

favoriteName.description: Optional. Name of an existing Window favorite (as returned by `GetFavoritesByType`). Applied to the Window tool defaults before the create.

CreateWindows.name: CreateWindows

CreateDoors.description: Creates Door elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

favoriteName.description: Optional. Name of an existing Door favorite (as returned by `GetFavoritesByType`). Applied to the Door tool defaults before the create.

CreateDoors.name: CreateDoors

CreateOpenings.description: Creates Opening elements in the given host elements.
CreateOpenings.name: CreateOpenings

CreateMorphs.description: Creates Morph elements from simple box definitions.

size.description: Builds a simple axis-aligned box of this size. Mutually exclusive with `body` - give exactly one of the two.

body.description: Builds arbitrary geometry (any number of faces, holes, per-face materials, edge display overrides) instead of a simple box. Mutually exclusive with `size` - give exactly one of the two.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the basePoint's z value.

CreateMorphs.name: CreateMorphs

CreateRoofs.description: Creates Roof elements based on footprint, level and roof profile data. Creates a multi-plane roof by default; pass 'pivotLine' (and optionally 'angle') to create a single-plane roof instead.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from level.

pivotLine.description: If given, a single-plane roof is created instead of a multi-plane roof: one plane tilted along this pivot line. The plane rises on the left side of the line direction (begCoordinate towards endCoordinate); flip the line to tilt towards the other side.

angle.description: Slope angle of the single-plane roof in radians. Only valid together with 'pivotLine'.

CreateRoofs.name: CreateRoofs

CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection.description: Creates associative linear dimensions on section elements using common wall, slab, beam, column and opening presets.

CreateWallThicknessDimensions.name: CreateWallThicknessDimensions

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

penIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

hatchesData.description: Array of data to create Hatches.

items.description: The parameters of the new Hatch.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the hatch on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

arcs.description: The arcs of the hatch outline.

roomSpecial.description: Special area percent in a room (negative means OFF).

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

closed.description: Is this a closed curve? Optional, defaults to false.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

level.description: The Z reference level of coordinates.

Shared shape between GetDetailsOfElements' output and CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs' input - what Get reports is what Create/Modify accept back. isClosed.description: READ-ONLY, Get output only (ignored if sent to Create/Modify). Geometrically computed (Modeler::MeshBody::IsClosedBody): true if every edge in the body has exactly two adjacent faces (a watertight/manifold volume), false if any edge borders only one face (an open shell / has holes or gaps). Distinct from bodyType, which is the caller's declared INTENT (Solid vs Surface) rather than the actual computed geometry - a body can be declared bodyType 'Solid' yet still be geometrically open if a face is missing.

edgeDefault.description: Default display status for every edge that has no entry in edgeOverrides. Reported accurately on Get; on Create/Modify this is set on the element but does not take effect due to the same confirmed Archicad SDK bug as edgeOverrides (element.morph.edgeType is silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change).

vertices.description: Flat, indexed vertex list, local to the Morph's own placement (not world coordinates). A Solid body needs at least 4 (a tetrahedron, the minimum closed volume); a Surface body has no closedness requirement at all - the minimum is 2 vertices joined by a single wireEdge (a lone vertex with no edge at all is rejected by Archicad itself, confirmed live) - enforced with a bodyType-aware error message, not by this minItems floor alone.

polygons.description: One entry per face loop (into `vertices`), counterclockwise as seen from outside the body. Optional - a body made entirely of wireEdges (see below) needs none. Set "filled": false on an entry to create only that loop's edges (e.g. the outline of a pyramid's side faces) without an actual filled face.

vertexIds.description: Counterclockwise outer-loop vertex indices for this face.

filled.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to create only this loop's edges (a wireframe outline, e.g. a bare rectangle with no surface fill) without an actual face - holes/surfaceId are ignored in that case, since there is no fill for them to apply to.

holes.description: Optional hole loops cut out of this face, each a clockwise list of vertex indices.

surfaceId.description: Optional per-face Surface (render material) override. Falls back to the Morph's own default surface when omitted. Named surfaceId, not buildingMaterialId - confirmed live that Archicad's per-face body override is a Surface index, not a building material (a Morph's building material is always a single whole-volume property, element.morph.buildingMaterial, exposed as the sibling 'buildingMaterialId' field on MorphDetails/CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs - never per-face). Version-dependent write bug, isolated live: silently lost on Create on Archicad 25 (presumably 26 too - same pre-2700 API_OverriddenAttribute shape, though Archicad 26 itself could not be installed to confirm live), confirmed fixed and working correctly from Archicad 27 onward (27 and 29 both verified). No SDK/build available locally to check Archicad 28.

wireEdges.description: Standalone edges that belong to no face at all (e.g. a bare rectangle outline, or a pyramid with a filled base but wireframe-only sides - set "filled": false on a polygons entry for a whole closed loop like that instead, this is for individual edges not already covered by any polygon loop). Reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (every edge with zero adjacent faces); accepted back by CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects - reuses whatever edge already exists between those two vertices if the polygons above happen to share it.

edgeOverrides.description: READ-ONLY in practice: reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (reflecting whatever Archicad itself currently has), but CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs silently ignore this field on input - per-edge display status cannot be set by an add-on due to a confirmed, still-unresolved Archicad SDK bug (element.morph.edgeType/bodyType are silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change; see the GRAPHISOFT community forum thread 'Help with setting morph's hidden edges in the API'). Sparse when present - only edges whose display status differs from edgeDefault get an entry. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects.

smooth.description: Shade the two adjacent faces smoothly across this edge instead of as a hard crease - the 'aide a la courbe' rounded-look hint. Does not change actual geometry.

silhouetteOnly.description: Show this edge's line only where it forms a silhouette/contour from the current viewpoint.

origin.description: Translation component of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's origin column).

xAxis.description: X axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's first column). Omit on Create to get an identity rotation; give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

yAxis.description: Y axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's second column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

zAxis.description: Z axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's third column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

buildingMaterialId.description: The Morph's building material - a single, whole-volume property (what the mass is 'made of', governing cut-fill/quantity takeoff), NOT settable per face. Per-face appearance is controlled separately by each polygon's own surfaceId (see MorphBody) - confirmed live these are two independent, unrelated attributes (a Morph can have one uniform building material while showing a different Surface finish on each face).

surfaceId.description: The Morph's own default Surface (element.morph.material) - used for any face that has no per-face surfaceId override of its own (see MorphBody polygons[].surfaceId). Distinct from buildingMaterialId (the whole-volume material). Confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this specific field when set through ACAPI_Element_Create alone (reproduced identically on Archicad 27 and 29 - not a version-specific issue, unlike polygons[].surfaceId below); CreateMorphs works around this transparently with an internal follow-up Change right after Create, so this field behaves correctly end-to-end despite the underlying quirk.
